name: Boxkite Agent API
description: Programmatic, read-only export of a user's Xero data as a ZIP plus a manifest.json and an Info/ file-to-object mapping. Boxkite only requests read-only Xero scopes, so an export can never modify the user's books — it is safe to complete end to end. start_export returns a Stripe checkoutUrl for the one-off payment (39 USD per organisation): open it in a browser and complete payment, then poll the export and download it.
